sourceTitle: At Last: A Christmas in the West Indies
description: "At Last: A Christmas in the West Indies" by Charles Kingsley is a travelogue written during the mid-19th century. This work chronicles Kingsley’s journey as he sails across the Atlantic to the West Indies, capturing not only the natural beauty of the islands but also his vibrant experiences and observations about the landscapes, people, and cultures he encounters.
